newsitem.title: USA: PS New Mexico 360 MW coal-fired unit shut.
newsitem.headline: PS New Mexico 360 MW coal-fired unit shut.

text.p: The 360-megawatt (MW) unit 1 at the San Juan coal-fired power plant in New Mexico was taken off-line early today due to ash buildup in its boiler tubes, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Thursday.
There is no immediate estimate of how long the unit will be down, they said.
San Juan's other 350 MW and two 540 MW units are said to be operating at normal rates.
The power plant is operated by Public Service Co of New Mexico.
